source: runs/s67r/j2_s1_default.json (final default: Glm53Generator(mesh), 1 slot, combo_a_kv without the stage-8 kda_in decode program, max_seq_len 280,576); short-context row runs/s67r/j2b_s1_16k.json (same code, max_seq_len 16,384); multi-slot runs/s67r/j3_s8.json, j4_s32.json
layer_stack_lower_bound_note: stage-5 sum of the 45 layers' traced replays at stage-5 reference precision (GLM53_PRECISION=none) on the shipped DEFAULT_MC (doc/optimized_multichip_decoder/README.md); not measured at combo_a_kv. The earlier 52.3 ms was measured with ag_persistent on
device_time_note: no device-time estimate at combo_a_kv and 280,576 tokens. The stage-7-precision estimate (stage-5 per-kind device time 865 / 1070 / 1332 us x (3, 31, 11) = 50.4 ms + LM head 0.47 + sampler 0.38 = 51.3 ms) applies to the 16,384-token row only (model trace 50.71 ms). At 280,576 the sparse indexer scores the whole allocated pool (+5.1 ms, see named_limitations)
roofline_note: DRAM roofline per decoder layer from stage 5 (doc/optimized_multichip_decoder): kda_dense 175, kda_moe 169, dsa_moe 179 us per layer per die (weight + cache bytes / DRAM bandwidth) x (3, 31, 11) layers + LM head 168 MB / 512 GB/s ~ 0.33 ms = 8.1 ms per token (stage-7 precision weight bytes; combo_a_kv's bfp4 projections lower it slightly)
named_limitations: context-size cost: the sparse DSA indexer scores every allocated pool slot (P_alloc from max_seq_len), not the filled prefix: 16,384 vs 280,576 -> token-out 51.10 vs 56.24 ms (+10 %), TTFT at 8,192 tokens 4,408 vs 6,444 ms (+46 %); planned fix (stage 10, PLAN.md 'cap at max position'): score the filled prefix, bucketed
decoder layers are ~97 % of the step; terminal path (LM head 471 us, sampler 0.39 ms, glue ~0.25 ms) ~1.1 ms
LM head 471 us interleaved bfp8 (168 MB per die); DRAM-sharded column splits slower (10 x 66 us)
128-row prefill chunk is device-bound (~5 ms per layer): prefill traces save 10 ms only

persistent decode all-gather (ag_persistent) is off in the shipped DEFAULT_MC: not adopted (capacity re-probe cost); available via MCOpts. Re-tested on the fixed code: quality identical (TF on 3 references, reduced 8-slot repeats), 0.44 ms per token faster (49.96 vs 50.40 ms at 16,384, runs/s7r2/agp{0,1}.json); capacity impact unmeasured
inactive-row MoE skip rebuilds its sentinel in each of 42 MoE layers: +1.1 % at 8 active (112.24 vs 110.97 ms skip off)
device time of the full step not profiled (full-stack Tracy forbidden); 1-layer Tracy windows (2026-10-17) are stale
